s.t: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Our Product Managers imagine the ideal experience for our community and work backwards, creating innovative products that delight our guests and hosts. They deeply understand the needs of our users and translate these into a strategy that combines strong product thinking and deep research.

They partner with talented cross-functional team members across engineering, design, operations, data science, and more, leading teams to execute a shared vision. They are incredibly detail-oriented and hands on.

Airbnb is seeking an exceptional product manager to reimagine how guests search on Airbnb. Search is the front door to the entire guest experience — the moment someone tells us what they want and we have to understand it, then show them the right options in the right order. Today that means query understanding, filtering, and ranking.

Tomorrow it means next-generation AI capabilities that let guests search more naturally, get better matches with less effort, and trust that Airbnb understood what they were actually looking for.
In this role, you will own the vision and roadmap for the future of search at Airbnb — pushing beyond keyword and filter-based search toward more intelligent, conversational, and personalized ways for guests to find their perfect stay. You'll partner closely with engineering, design, and data science teams to bring new AI-powered search capabilities from concept to guests.
This is a high-visibility role building one of the most consequential surfaces in the guest experience, and will regularly interface with senior engineering and leadership stakeholders.

Define and drive the long-term vision and roadmap for the future of search on Airbnb, including next-generation AI capabilities like natural language and conversational search, query understanding, and intelligent ranking.
Own how guests search on Airbnb end to end — from the moment they express intent to the moment they find the right option.
Partner closely with engineering, applied ML, and data science teams to design, prototype, and ship AI-powered search experiences.
Use quantitative analysis and experimentation (A/B testing) to validate that new search capabilities improve relevance, conversion, and guest satisfaction.
Translate ambiguous guest problems into clear product requirements, prioritized against business impact and technical feasibility.
Collaborate with design and research to understand how guests search, filter, and decide today — and where AI can remove friction.
Work cross-functionally with Host-side and Trust teams to ensure smarter search continues to surface the right inventory fairly and accurately.
Communicate roadmap, results, and trade-offs clearly to engineering partners and leadership.

10+ years of consumer product management experience, with a track record of owning a product area end to end.
Experience working on search, discovery, ranking, or recommendation systems is strongly preferred.
Genuine excitement about applying modern AI and ML capabilities (LLMs, semantic search, conversational interfaces) to consumer product problems.
Strong business acumen and ability to use data, research, and experimentation to drive product strategy and decisions.
Demonstrated ability to work closely with ML/data science teams and understand the trade-offs of model-driven products.
Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills across engineering, design, data science, and other cross-functional teams.
A user-centered mindset — you dig into how guests actually search and where they get stuck, not just metrics dashboards.

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Stripe's Professional Services (ProServ) team helps businesses around the world design, implement, and optimise their Stripe integrations. As we scale our global delivery capability, we are building a structured portfolio of service offerings that define the scope, methodology, resourcing, and commercial terms of how we engage with our users.

We are looking for a Product Manager ( Professional Services) to own the portfolio of offerings end-to-end. The role sits at the intersection of services strategy, commercial design, and delivery operations. You will be the person who determines whether our offerings are well-designed, effectively sold, and profitably delivered and you will take action to refine the portfolio as needed.
This is not a traditional Product Manager role, but it demands the same rigour. Your "product" is the service itself: its scope, its pricing, its methodology, and its performance. You will work closely with Sales, Delivery, Finance, and Stripe's Product organisation to ensure that every offering in our portfolio is fit for purpose and continuously improving.

Own the offering portfolio for Professional Services
Maintain and govern ProServ’s offering portfolio including scope, hours, pricing, and resource plans for each offering. Our portfolio includes offerings designed for all user segments from start-ups to enterprises
Manage the full offering lifecycle: design, build, launch, iterate, and deprecate offerings based on market need, delivery performance, and product roadmap changes
Ensure the portfolio stays current as Stripe launches new products
Design and implement a governance framework for the portfolio of offerings
Drive offering performance analytics
Define and track the offering KPIs: attach rate, average scope deviation, planned vs. actual burn rate, gross margin per offering, and customer satisfaction
Run regular performance reviews and present findings to ProServ leadership with clear recommendations
Refine and Improve Offering Design
Analyse delivery burn data to identify offerings that are systematically over- or under-scoped, and propose refinements
Conduct structured retrospectives with Delivery Leads after engagement close to capture insights and feedback
Serve as the structured feedback loop between Delivery (what is hard to deliver), Sales (what is hard to sell), and Finance (what is margin-accretive), synthesising those inputs into offering design decisions

Required
7+ years of Professional Services or consulting delivery experience
Demonstrable experience shaping or owning a service offering
Commercial literacy
Strong analytical skills
Excellent written communication
Product Management training or experience
The ability to apply product thinking (hypothesis, prototype, measure, iterate) to service design

Familiarity with Certinia and/or Salesforce
Exposure to partner and SI ecosystem dynamics

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits.

If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase .
We're hiring a Group Product Manager to lead the Compliance Agent Experience product team within our EAA organization.

This team builds the internal tooling and AI-powered investigation experiences used by Compliance Operations to execute Coinbase's financial crime programs, including AML Transaction Monitoring, KYC, Enhanced Due Diligence, and Sanctions/Screening.

You'll own the automation-first roadmap that enables investigators to triage alerts, assess risk, and document decisions faster and more accurately, so humans focus on high-judgment work while the platform handles repeatable tasks at scale.

Own the Compliance Agent Experience product area end-to-end, from vision and strategy through execution, covering AML/TMS, KYC, EDD, and Sanctions/Screening investigation surfaces.
Drive a multi-year roadmap for AI-assisted, human-in-the-loop investigation workflows that measurably reduce cycle time, improve decision quality, and increase automation adoption.
Lead build-vs-buy and vendor strategy for investigation enablement (OSINT, case enrichment, LLM tooling), including evaluations and RFPs in partnership with Compliance, Legal, Security, and Procurement.
Partner with Engineering, Data Science/ML, Compliance Program owners, and CX Operations to deliver integrated tooling that reduces context-switching and improves end-to-end investigation throughput.
Establish success metrics and instrumentation for Compliance tooling (investigation cycle time, AHT, escalation rates, QA outcomes, false positive reduction, automation adoption) and report progress to executive stakeholders through regular business reviews.
Shape security, privacy, and auditability requirements, including access controls, data retention, audit trails, and model governance, ensuring regulatory readiness without compromising investigator usability.

10+ years of product management experience, including 5+ years leading and developing PM teams, with a track record of shipping internal tooling or operational platforms at global scale.
Demonstrated experience building AI/ML-powered automation or workflow products (e.g., LLM-based assistants, human-in-the-loop decisioning, intelligent case routing) in compliance, fintech, or similarly regulated domains.
Deep familiarity with AML, transaction monitoring, investigations, sanctions screening, or KYC/EDD operations, including auditability and regulator-facing requirements.
Proven ability to define measurable outcomes (throughput, quality, automation rates), instrument product surfaces, and use data to drive roadmap prioritization across a multi-team portfolio.
Track record of leading cross-functional programs spanning engineering, compliance, data science, and operations with 5+ teams, and communicating strategy and tradeoffs to VP+ audiences.
Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. TwoTwenty is Pinterest's incubation team. We invented Shuffles and Collages and we're the team behind Beauty Guides, Restyle and Smart Blocks. We're hiring a product manager to own one of our shipping products end to end, or to lead one of our next zero-to-one bets from a blank page to real users.

Own a product on TwoTwenty end to end, from strategy through post-launch iteration. You'll pick between a substantial slice of the teams AI Experiences charter or one of the team's next bets in areas like generative creation tools, live shopping or AI planning surfaces.
Make the product decisions that separate a demo from a product. You'll decide what ships in V1, defend the cut list and set the quality bar on your surface so designers and engineers calibrate to it.
Land launches that require alignment with partner teams inside Pinterest (AIFwd, Search, Shop with Pinterest, ATG). You'll get to agreement without needing your manager in the room.
Translate a company-level thesis into a concrete product decision your team can build against. You'll be able to state your product's strategy in one sentence and connect this week's engineering work to it.
Run experiments that answer real questions, not experiments that produce metrics. You'll decide when a null result is a launch signal and when a positive result isn't good enough.
Use AI to accelerate exploration, drafting and analysis in your day-to-day. This includes prototyping concepts, comparing design options and synthesizing user research, while applying judgment and verification to protect correctness and quality.
Mentor at least one PM or designer on the team on the craft of narrowing a problem before writing the doc.

Minimum of 6 years of product management experience, including shipping a consumer product with an AI or ML component to at least one million users.
Experience owning a zero-to-one product from a blank page through real user traffic, not a prototype in a deck.
Experience saying no to a well-liked feature request from an executive and holding the line on quality.
Experience earning the trust of a senior engineering leader on architectural decisions, and can describe how you did it.
Understanding of the difference between a strategy and a plan, and the ability to state your current team's strategy in one sentence.
Experience using AI to accelerate product exploration, competitive analysis or user research synthesis, with a clear approach to validating accuracy and quality before decisions get made.
Committed to owning outcomes end to end. You treat things outside your scope as yours when the product needs it, and you don't lean on process to make decisions the team is looking to you for.
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as computer science, design, human-computer interaction or business, or equivalent experience.

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Fuel and energy is the single largest controllable cost line for almost every fleet on the planet, and most of that money is still spent on gut feel and spreadsheets. Samsara sees exactly how these fleets run, every mile, every gallon, every idle minute. That data is the foundation for a new class of products, and the upside is real: billions of dollars in savings for our customers, and a meaningful cut to their emissions along with it.
As a Senior Product Manager, you'll own a product area end to end, from the customer problem to something the world's largest fleets rely on every day. The team's scope is broad — fuel cards and payments, driver and vehicle efficiency, the EV transition, operational cost intelligence — and you'll go deep on one of these.

Much of this space has no existing playbook, especially where AI can now catch waste no spreadsheet ever could. It also means working differently: prototyping with AI, testing ideas in days instead of quarters.
You'll spend real time with customers, and just as much with go-to-market on pricing, packaging, and how we tell the savings story, because here selling the value is as much a product decision as building it.
We're hiring for the best product generalists we can find, not for fuel or fleet experience. Find the real customer problem, build conviction, ship a measurable outcome: the domain you learned that in doesn't matter to us.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United States (East and Central Timezones) & Canada as well as in the United Kingdom.

You're a strong generalist product manager first: you've built your career on customer discovery, prioritization, and driving cross-functional teams to outcomes. The domain (consumer, fintech, marketplace, whatever) matters far less to us than the muscle.
You form your own point of view: you don't wait to be told what's worth building. You build conviction from customer evidence and can defend it, even when it differs from where the org was leaning.
You think and communicate in a straight line: you can take an ambiguous or messy problem and explain it - and your recommendation - clearly and concisely, leading with the answer rather than the journey to get there.
You want real ownership: you'll own a product area's vision, strategy, and roadmap, including the business outcome, not just the shipped feature. If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara.
You appreciate candid feedback and an experimental mindset : Samsara employees challenge the status quo and recognize failure as part of the learning process. We encourage each other to be honest and hold ourselves to high standards.

Run deep discovery with the people who live these problems — fleet owners, fuel managers, operations leaders, and finance teams — and turn what you learn into a strategy that ships.
Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for a key product area, including the business case behind it, not just the backlog.
Prototype and design MVPs yourself - clickable flows, working demos, rough cuts, often AI-assisted - to pressure-test ideas with customers before committing engineering time.
Ship customer-facing experiences end to end with design, engineering, and data science, and know enough about the underlying data and systems to be a credible, equal partner.
Define success metrics, build business cases for new initiatives, and drive a continuous cycle of experimentation and iteration grounded in data and customer feedback.

5+ years in product management, with a track record of shipping customer-facing products used by real customers at scale (not primarily backend, platform, or internal-tooling work).
You can point to something you designed, prototyped and built yourself, and a cross-functional launch you drove end to end, including the business outcome it produced (revenue, cost, adoption, retention, whatever the right measure was).
You're comfortable contributing to commercial and go-to-market decisions (pricing, packaging, GTM strategy, or a business case) - not just what to build, but why it's worth building.
You’re data-driven: you are able to dive into data to identify opportunities and then measure your impact. You prioritise the value you can add to customers, and can get other teams behind you by telling stories with data.
You have your own product point of view, backed by customer evidence, and you'll defend it even under pushback.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Experience shipping 0-to-1 products of real scale and complexity, in any domain.
Experience shipping products that depend on partnerships, integrations, or external data - ecosystems beyond your own engineering team.
Experience shipping AI- or ML-powered features.

At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.
As the Senior Product Manager, Design Systems at Vanta, you'll own the product strategy and roadmap for how every team builds Vanta's interface.

Your mission is to build the horizontal tooling that lets product, engineering, and design teams create consistent, high-quality user experiences faster, so they can spend more of their time on their customers.

To be successful, you’ll need to have a high level of product taste and be able to set and hold the line for high quality and easy to use products. All while working closely with your engineering and design manager partners.
You'll be part of Vanta's Platform organization, which builds the foundational primitives and craft layer the rest of the product is built on. This is the first dedicated Design Systems PM role at Vanta, so you'll help shape the function itself, not just the roadmap. It's a high-autonomy, highly cross-functional role at the center of how Vanta looks, feels, and scales.
What you’ll do as a Senior Product Manager, Design Systems at Vanta:
Own the vision and roadmap for the frontend, spanning the design system and the front-end platform, and ladder durable platform investments to company initiatives so design and engineering can focus on customers.
Evolve our design system from a broad component library into smaller, composable building blocks with consistent APIs, including making components first-class for AI and LLM-driven experiences.
Drive accessibility and internationalization programs to their committed milestones, including global-scale localization and meeting accessibility standards.
Partner with our AI team to enable the agentic patterns product teams need to build the next generation of Vanta experiences.
Run go-to-market and adoption for design-system changes, and lead ongoing quality and "paper cuts" triage as the craft team for the entire product.
Partner closely with your engineering and design leads as a triad, continuously prioritizing the highest-impact work across a wide surface area.
Look 12 to 18 months ahead at how the design system and front-end platform scale with Vanta, including AI-native use.

s.h: How to be successful in this role
s.t:
Have 4-8+ years of product management experience, with real ownership of a design system, frontend platform, or developer and design experience that served many teams.
Bring craft and taste at scale. You have a clear point of view on quality, you can scale it across many teams, and you earn craft credibility with senior design and product leaders.
Have a builder's mindset. You're not an engineer, but you're hands-on: you spin up prototypes and demos and build with the same component building blocks that your team ships.
Collaborate horizontally and build trust. You serve every product team as an internal platform, build consensus across the company, and you're the partner other teams are glad to see at their door.
Think in systems. You reason about how components, tokens, patterns, and front-end infrastructure fit together and cascade across every product surface.
Tell the story. You translate why front-end and design-system investment matters into clear business value for leadership and cross-functional partners.
Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work, demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.
Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

Luno has spent over a decade making digital assets safe to own. That discipline built the licences, banking relationships, custody and compliance machinery that the next era of this market will run on
The financial system is moving on-chain. Stablecoins are the only digital asset class operating at institutional scale today, and while 98% of supply is dollar-pegged, roughly half of global payment flows are not. That gap is the opportunity, and it is largest in exactly the markets Luno has spent twelve years building in.

You will join the Product Management team building Luno’s institutional business: the activation, digital asset account infrastructure and issuance products that let businesses, institutions and partners operate on the rails Luno has spent over a decade building. You will run onboarding and verification as a single platform: one machine, configured per business line and per region, where each business line owns its own risk appetite and due diligence policy and you own everything that executes it.

You will sit with institutional customers to understand where onboarding loses them, work directly with verification vendors, and treat evolving regulators’ requirements as design inputs rather than blockers.

You’re joining the team that built and maintains Luno’s entire identity verification system across all markets for retail and institutional customers and will need to carefully balance how we build new features, while maintaining the integrity of our existing integrations and processes.

Own the business and institutional onboarding platform end-to-end: KYB, verification, screening, periodic refresh, and the journey from first application to first transaction
Configuration per business line: Luno Institutional and BlockTower each carry their own CDD standards and risk appetite, in segregated environments, on the platform you own
Measure time-to-onboard and abandonment: find where institutions drop out, discover why, and design the changes that fix it
Own the relationship with verification vendors: integration, performance, cost and our roadmap
Extend the platform to multi-region and global onboarding: working with legal, risk and country teams to turn a regulatory position into a compliant product
Partner with our operations teams: reduce manual effort per case, so specialists handle the complex work and automations handle the rest

You have built products in onboarding, identity, KYC/KYB, compliance tooling or an adjacent domain
You are technically comfortable where product meets integration: vendor APIs, environment configuration, and how identity data moves between systems, in enough depth to make good trade-offs with engineers
You are rigorous with data: you can find where a journey leaks, quantify what it costs, and prioritise accordingly
You own delivery, not just definition: you work with engineering teams in a continuous rhythm and hold yourself accountable for what ships and what it achieves
You manage stakeholders as a craft: keeping operations, vendors and institutional customers aligned, communicating risks early, and garnering support through clear, concise writing
You work well with compliance, legal and risk teams, and you can hold a position on customer experience while respecting a regulatory obligation

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to know our team
In Product, ideas come alive. The world moves fast, and our culture is built on ownership, speed, and minimal bureaucracy. This is the environment that empowers you to make decisions, move quickly, and do what you believe is right. Our Product Managers move fast, learn from failure, and continuously iterate.
As a product-centric organization, we work cross-functionally to build products from conception to launch, bringing together engineering, design, data, and business teams. Agoda Product Managers work closely with executive leadership and have high visibility across the organization, with direct impact on the company’s growth and strategy. We put travelers first and aim to create exceptional travel experiences through innovative product thinking.
The opportunity
This role is based in Bangkok/Seoul based. Our Senior Product Managers are analytical, hands-on, and highly data-driven. They are responsible for building products end-to-end, using analysis, experimentation, and rapid iteration to create solutions that are tailored to traveler needs.
As our next Senior Product Manager, Localization (Korea Market), you will define product strategy and drive execution for experiences serving Korean travelers. You will partner closely with senior cross-functional stakeholders to identify opportunities, build impactful products, and deliver high-quality solutions for the Korea market.
You will work with dedicated engineering resources that you help prioritize and allocate. We expect you to be hands-on, spend meaningful time with your SCRUM teams, and bring strong product judgment, experimentation mindset, and execution rigor. This role offers the opportunity to shape localized experiences at scale and influence how Agoda serves one of its key markets. This is an Individual Contributor role.
In this role, you’ll get to
Develop a deep understanding of the online travel ecosystem, market dynamics, competitive landscape, and user needs in the Korea market
Define, build, launch, and optimize products and features through testing, experimentation, and rapid iteration
Drive localization initiatives that improve the experience for Korean travelers across the product journey
Partner closely with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, Design, Analytics, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions
Translate market insights, customer needs, and business priorities into clear product strategies and roadmaps
Use data and quantitative analysis to identify opportunities, prioritize effectively, and measure product performance
Collaborate across regions, product areas, and functions to solve complex problems and drive meaningful business impact
What you’ll need to succeed
Bachelor’s degree in a technical or quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline
Proven ability to use analytics and quantitative methods to inform strategy, prioritization, and decision-making
Strong data skills, with the ability to independently analyze performance and generate actionable insights
Excellent communication skills in either Korean with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and influence a wide range of stakeholders
Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and influence a wide range of stakeholders
Proven experience in Korea market localization, with a deep understanding of Korean consumers, market dynamics, and local product requirements
Experience developing, launching, and optimizing products in a fast-paced environment
Experience leading product strategy, go-to-market thinking, and cross-functional product development discussions
Strong entrepreneurial mindset and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to break down complexity and drive change
Hands-on approach with a strong sense of ownership and execution
It’s great if you have
MBA or Master’s degree in Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field
Experience with data tools such as SQL, Python, R, or equivalent

This is Adyen
Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
Senior Product Manager, Global Acquiring
Adyen's Global Acquiring team powers the core card payment infrastructure behind billions of transactions worldwide. Through our direct connections with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, Diners Club, JCB, and China UnionPay, we enable merchants to accept payments globally with industry-leading reliability, performance, and innovation.
As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the strategy and roadmap for critical parts of our global acquiring platform. You'll build the products that improve authorization rates, maximize merchant conversion, strengthen platform reliability, and enable Adyen to launch new payment capabilities and expand into new markets.
You'll work at the intersection of engineering, payment networks, partnerships, commercial teams, compliance, and operations to transform the complex payments industry into scalable innovative platform capabilities that benefit every Adyen merchant. Your work will shape how millions of payments are processed every day while ensuring our platform remains the most reliable and innovative acquiring solution in the industry.

Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for a critical area of Adyen's Global Acquiring.
Build scalable acquiring capabilities that improve payment performance, increase authorization rates, and maximize merchant conversion.
Partner directly with Visa, Mastercard, American Express and other global payment networks to influence roadmaps, implement new capabilities, and ensure ongoing compliance.
Drive complex cross-functional initiatives across Engineering, Partnerships, Commercial, Compliance, Operations and Product teams.
Translate changing scheme requirements into scalable platform capabilities rather than one-off merchant solutions.
Use data to identify opportunities that improve merchant performance, operational efficiency, and platform scalability.
Lead difficult product decisions through influence, aligning stakeholders across multiple organizations without direct authority.
Mentor other product managers and contribute to raising the overall quality of product management within the organization.

You have 8+ years of Product Management experience building complex software products at scale.
You have domain knowledge in Payments or Fintech; preferably with knowledge of card acquiring.
You have successfully led highly cross-functional initiatives involving engineering, commercial teams, partnerships, and external partners.
You can simplify highly technical payment infrastructure into clear product strategies and business outcomes.
You are highly analytical and use data to drive prioritization and measure impact.
You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and consistently turn complex problems into scalable product solutions.
You are an excellent communicator who can influence senior stakeholders both internally and externally.
You care deeply about building products that create measurable value for merchants while strengthening Adyen's platform.

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking.

With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.
We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.
Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

This role will be working at the heart of the GoCardless product in our Payment Flows team, within the Bank Payment Network Group. The team ensures that merchant money is settled quickly, with high certainty, on every payment scheme we provide. You will define and build propositions that provide market leading outcomes: building the capabilities to settle money faster, leveraging ML to confirm payments sooner, and unlocking payment capabilities that give merchants the best experience.
The Senior Product Manager will work closely with the team’s Engineering Manager and Data Scientist to lead the product improvements that help our customers and drive revenue. You will also collaborate closely with Product Marketing, Customer Success, and other Product teams to achieve great outcomes for our customers and work towards our product vision.
What excites you
Delivering customer and business value : Being relentlessly focused on understanding and solving the customer problems which result in them using GoCardless as much as they can.
Problem discovery and prioritisation: Taking complex and ambiguous product problems and structuring these effectively. This includes clearly defining the problem space, the impact of the problem and your prioritisation process.
Data-led decision-making: Using quantitative and qualitative evidence to support your decisions and opportunity identification.
Defining Product Strategy: Identifying key customer segments, and our approach to meeting their needs over the longer term in ways that create value for them and GoCardless
Influencing and communication: Building collaborative relationships with your team, stakeholders and executives to deliver change effectively across your remit. This includes growing to become the ‘go-to’ person for your product area; translating complex, technical problems into understandable concepts; and convincing stakeholders of the best approach using structured reasoning.
Leadership: Setting direction and coordinating action across a range of teams and functions
Shipping stuff: Working with your team to support changes to completion, delivering consistent positive impact across your product area. Being comfortable delivering a range of projects: from MVP experiments testing a hypothesis to a new feature.
What excites us
Delivery of impact: You are focused on delivering business value through experimentation and have experience of doing that.
Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills: We want our Product Managers to have an outstanding ability to tackle valuable customer and business problems. At GoCardless we start by asking ‘why?’, and a data-led approach is central to how we run Product. You have a customer centric approach and are comfortable with qualitative and quantitative analysis.
High agency: We’re after people who aren’t afraid of a challenge and will take ownership of problems they come across and help to resolve them and adapt to a constantly changing environment.
Collaborative leaders: Product roles bring responsibility without direct authority. We’re looking for leaders who can motivate and earn the trust of stakeholders and teams with a collaborative approach.
We don’t expect you to meet every requirement. If you’re excited by this role, we encourage you to apply.

At Algolia, we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests — four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.
In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.
The Mission
Your product mission is to make Algolia the builder-first platform for agentic applications. Agent Studio empowers developers and business users to compose retrieval, memory, workflows, tools, and evaluation in one place - then ship those workflows to production with confidence. You will equip customers with the ability to go from prototype to production quickly, reliably, and with governance built in.
The Opportunity
As a Staff Product Manager at Algolia, you will shape the vision and execution of Agent Studio, the front door to Algolia’s Agentic Platform. This role is critical in defining how Algolia becomes the default environment for building, evaluating, and scaling agent workflows. You will collaborate across engineering, design, product marketing, and GTM to deliver impactful results, multiply the impact of other PMs, and contribute directly to the company’s long-term success.

Drive product discovery to define the who, why, and what of Agent Studio.
Formulate, align, and communicate the strategy, vision, and roadmap for Agent Studio across the organization.
Define the abstraction layers (workflow blocks, memory & tool adapters, eval harnesses, guardrails) that let developers and business users build reliably.
Mock up concepts, write functional specs, cut tickets, draft copy : whatever it takes to push the product throughout its lifecycle.
Partner deeply with engineers, designers, and other PMs to ship delightful, powerful builder experiences.
Shape agile processes and foster team dynamics that encourage continuous learning, rapid prototyping, and eval-driven iteration.
Build and scale an evaluation culture (offline + online): golden sets, regressions, quality metrics, and ship gates.
Use analytical and quantitative skills to track adoption, cost, latency, and quality managing the business by the numbers.
Stay ahead of the competitive landscape (agent frameworks, eval platforms, orchestration tools) and identify strategic partnerships to strengthen the ecosystem.
Engage directly with customers and design partners to validate real-world agentic workflows.

Proven experience in building and shipping developer-first platforms, tools, or APIs.
Demonstrated success in shipping and iterating products within an agile development environment.
Ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and support to launch and scale products.
Strong ability to frame technical and business problems, craft strategies, and deliver simple solutions.
Deep curiosity and user empathy for both developers and business users.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

s.h: What would make you stand out
s.t:
Expertise in agentic workflows, retrieval (keyword, vector, hybrid), memory, or orchestration frameworks.
Familiarity with LLM evaluation, telemetry, governance, and provenance.
Technical background with hands-on coding experience (for fun, school, or work).
Experience in or strong understanding of eCommerce, content-heavy use cases, or media workflows.
Proven experience in designing workflow automation or builder tools that empower teams and enhance productivity.

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for building the world’s best search & discovery technology, we’d love to review your application!

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

Samsara’s Go-To-Market Systems (GTMS) team builds the internal products that power how Samsara sells — the quoting, approvals, and opportunity workflows that thousands of sellers rely on every day. As a Senior Business Technology Product Manager on our Sales Execution pod, you’ll own the seller experience end to end: finding the highest-friction moments in the deal cycle and shipping solutions that make our sellers faster, more accurate, and more confident.
This is a builder’s product role. You won’t just write requirements and hand them off; you’ll prototype, build, and iterate directly, using modern AI tools to raise your own leverage, with engineering partnering to harden your work for scale. You’ll partner closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Finance, and Engineering to translate complex go-to-market problems into scalable, measurable solutions across Salesforce and our CPQ/quote-to-cash stack.
This role is open to candidates residing in the US and Canada except Alaska, Austin Metro, Boulder Metro, California, Chicago Metro, Connecticut, Dallas Metro, Denver Metro, Houston Metro, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Seattle Metro, and Washington, D.C.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

Own the roadmap for seller-facing quoting, approvals, and opportunity workflows across Salesforce and CPQ — turning ambiguous go-to-market problems into shipped solutions with clear, measurable outcomes.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our Virtual Fencing team.
Virtual Fencing is the heart of Halter. It’s how thousands of farmers across the world manage their animals. Halter is often farmers #1 app on their phone and we have the privilege of building the experience that farmers use to look after their animals.
This role is all about deeply understanding what our farmers need from our product and taking those insights and converting them into beautiful elegant features that help our farmers run their farm. This role sits right at the intersection of technology and farming.

You will become an expert in virtual fencing; developing a deep understanding of how the technology works and how farmers and ranchers use it in practice. You’ll work closely with our farmers and the rest of the product team to build an epic product that changes lives.
You don’t necessarily need any Product Management experience but it’s crucial you understand farming. If you’re curious, hungry to learn, love solving hard problems and are passionate about agriculture, let’s talk!

You’ve worked on farm as a shepherd, farm hand, farm manager or as a Rural Professional so aren’t new to the realities of farming and you’re ready to take that experience into a role that directly helps farmers.
You’re highly curious and hungry to become an expert in Virtual Fencing and understand how the tech really works.
You love working at a fast pace with loose requirements. You’re confident navigating uncertainty, breaking down messy problems, testing ideas, pivoting and getting stuck in.
You’re a critical thinker who is able to break down complex problems. Even when the pressure’s on, you can get to simple solutions.
You can clearly and simply communicate concepts or decisions to engineers, farmers and other Halter teams.
You care about simplicity, usability and elegance. You sweat the details because you know they matter, especially for complex products used in demanding, real-world environments.

Help decide what gets built next and why, prioritising based on what'll make the biggest difference on farm.
Work closely with other Product Managers, Engineers and Designers to get features built and shipped.
Make sure new features actually land well for farmers, from rollout through to adoption

Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.
Healthy body, healthy mind. We're partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well-being.

Humans are wired for connection. Being office first is a core pillar of our culture because in-person connections drive your growth, learning, impact, and relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful work together.

Join our team

Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The Opportunity
Our PRM (Partner Relationship Management) platform is the operating system for MongoDB's entire partner ecosystem — the system partners and internal teams rely on for onboarding, deal registration, enablement content, incentives, and reporting.

We're looking for a Director, Business Product Manager to own the business vision and requirements for this platform: the strategic counterpart to the engineering/IT team that builds it.

This is a business-side role — you won't be writing code — but you need to understand PRM deeply enough to translate partner and internal stakeholder needs into a clear product vision, a prioritized roadmap, and requirements engineering can build against.
You'll report to the VP of Partner Strategic Operations and work as the connective tissue between the partner organization (Sales Plays & Offerings, Programs, Enablement, Digital Process & AI Operations) and the engineering/IT teams who build and maintain the platform.
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based anywhere in the US for our hybrid working model.

Own the vision and strategy
Define and own the long-term business vision and strategy for the PRM platform, anchored in the needs of partners and internal partner-organization stakeholders.
Build and maintain a prioritized product roadmap that balances competing demands from Sales Plays & Offerings, Programs, Enablement, Digital Process & AI Operations, and field/partner-facing teams.
Stay current on PRM market direction (Salesforce PRM, Impartner, Workspan, Zift, Crossbeam, and emerging AI-native entrants) to inform build-vs-buy and platform evolution decisions.

Run structured discovery with stakeholders across the partner organization to surface needs, pain points, and opportunities, and translate them into clear, prioritized requirements.
Author business requirements documents (BRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and IT can build against without ambiguity.
Maintain and groom the product backlog, balancing new capability requests against platform stability, data quality, and technical debt considerations raised by engineering.
Work cross-functionally to deliver
Act as the primary business-side liaison to Engineering/IT and any implementation partners or vendors, ensuring business intent survives translation into technical delivery.
Partner closely with the Digital Process & AI Operations lead to align on which PRM capabilities should be built as native platform features versus automations layered on top.
Lead or participate in UAT (user acceptance testing) cycles to confirm delivered functionality meets business requirements before release.
Drive change management and adoption for new PRM capabilities — communication, training materials, and enablement content in partnership with the Enablement team.
Measure and iterate
Define and track adoption and health metrics for the PRM platform (partner activation, feature adoption, ticket/escalation volume, NPS or satisfaction where available).
Report platform performance and roadmap progress to the VP of Partner Strategic Operations and other partner-organization stakeholders on a regular cadence.
Continuously reprioritize the roadmap based on usage data, stakeholder feedback, and evolving partner-ecosystem strategy.

8+ years of experience in product management, business systems, or business analysis roles, ideally with direct exposure to PRM, CRM, or other partner/channel technology platforms at a B2B SaaS or infrastructure/data company.
Deep working knowledge of how a PRM platform functions — partner onboarding, deal registration, MDF/incentive tracking, tiering, co-sell workflows — even without hands-on engineering or configuration experience.
A track record of authoring clear BRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and successfully partnering with engineering/IT teams to deliver against them.

Executive presence and communication skills; able to represent the business vision to senior leadership and translate technical constraints back to business stakeholders in plain language.
Experience running or participating in UAT, change management, and adoption efforts for enterprise platform rollouts.
Comfortable operating as a strategic business owner rather than a technical builder — this role does not require coding, scripting, or platform administration skills, but does require enough technical fluency to have credible, detailed conversations with engineering.

Background in cloud infrastructure, database, or developer-focused technology markets.

Job Description
At Docplanner, we run the #1 patient–doctor marketplace in most of the markets where we operate, connecting over 100 million patients every month with the doctors and clinics who care for them. Our mission is simple: to help people live longer, healthier lives.
Doctors and clinics pay to be on our marketplace because it delivers something they can measure – patients, bookings, and real return on their investment. The Visibility team exists to guarantee that outcome. When a doctor or clinic buys our Marketplace product, this team makes sure they are set up well, get found by the right patients, fill their calendars, and clearly see the ROI that keeps them with us for years.
As Senior Product Manager for Visibility, you will own the product and business logic that decides how doctors are ranked and surfaced across the marketplace, together with the paid visibility products (First Class, Media360) that let them grow further.

You will work hand in hand with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to turn a new customer into a thriving, retained one – distributing patient demand intelligently, reducing “zero-booking” doctors, and lifting retention and lifetime value across the base.
This is a highly commercial, deeply analytical product role at the core of how our marketplace creates value for both patients and the professionals who serve them.

Owning Doctor Success strategy and outcomes
Co-own the core success and health metrics for the marketplace customer base: retention, churn and the reduction of zero-booking (“zero-UB”) doctors.
Partner with Customer Success and Patient Marketing to set doctors up for success from onboarding through renewal, closing the loop between how a profile is configured and the bookings it generates.
Design differentiated success journeys for different customer segments, specialties, and maturity levels.
Owning ranking, relevance, and visibility logic
Own the business logic that governs how doctors and clinics are ranked, matched, and surfaced across marketplace search and listings.
Balance patient experience and relevance against doctor outcomes and commercial objectives, and define the guardrails that keep that balance healthy.
Define evaluation frameworks, success metrics, and experiments to measure and continuously improve ranking quality.
Owning paid visibility and growth products
Own the roadmap and business logic for our paid visibility products, including First Class (premium placement) and Media360 (managed patient-acquisition media).
Make the value of these products transparent to customers, so the ROI is obvious and repeatable.
Working data-first
Use SQL and analytics tools daily to answer your own questions, size opportunities, and validate decisions – without waiting on someone else to pull the numbers.
Instrument products well, define the metrics that matter, and build the dashboards and experiments the team runs on.

Supabase is the open-source Postgres development platform that 7M+ developers and thousands of enterprises depend on every day. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

We’re looking for a Product Manager, Marketplace to join our Product Team to lead our marketplace and integration surfaces.
The marketplace is the two-sided surface of the Supabase ecosystem. On one side, Partners and developers build integrations on top of Supabase primitives like Auth, Storage, and Edge Functions, then publish them for the world to use. On the other, our developers come to discover new capabilities and wire them into their projects without leaving their workflow. Done well, it is the shortest path between a developer with a problem and the exact capability that solves it.
That surface is about to matter more than ever. As the number of capabilities explodes, and as agents begin to assemble software on a developer's behalf, the marketplace becomes the distribution and discovery layer for the whole ecosystem: how both developers and, increasingly, their agents find, trust, and compose what they need. This role owns it.

Own the product strategy and roadmap for the marketplace, the two-sided surface where Partners and developers publish integrations and where Supabase's developer customers discover and install them.
Make it effortless for a developer to find the right capability and integrate it. Own discovery, search, listings, and the whole path from install to working integration, so a new capability connects to Supabase primitives and runs inside a developer's project with minimal glue code.
Make publishing an integration fast and rewarding, so Partners and developers bring their best work to the marketplace and keep it current, and so the catalog stays deep where developers need it.
Set the quality bar and the listing standards, and build the review, guardrail, and versioning mechanisms, with Engineering and our Partnerships team, that keep the catalog trustworthy as it scales.
Own what a healthy marketplace looks like: define the metrics across both supply and demand, instrument the surface end to end, and let the signal rather than opinion drive what gets built next.
Position the marketplace as the distribution layer for agent-driven development, where capabilities get discovered and composed on a builder's behalf rather than browsed and installed by hand.

You know version control is more than just a subsystem. It’s the backbone of how teams build software. You’re ready to shape the future of code-change workflows, from local commits to AI-assisted reviews. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning a core IDE feature into a standalone ecosystem, this is for you.
About JetBrains
We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

Version control is a critical part of our IDEs, but we want to take it further. We’re turning VCS into a strategic product direction and, eventually, we aim to grow it into a dedicated ecosystem. This role exists to define what that future looks like right now.
As the Senior Product Manager, you’ll figure out where JetBrains should play in the VCS space, how to evolve our Git and code review experiences, and what new opportunities exist beyond our current tools.

You’ll have the ownership to set a clear product vision that covers everything from complex local merges to remote, containerized, and AI-assisted workflows. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and quality leads, as well as product marketing, developer advocacy, and the IntelliJ Platform teams.

Together, you'll figure out how to handle the next era of software delivery, including tracking provenance and reviewing AI-generated changes across different environments.

Set the long-term product strategy for VCS and code-change workflows across all JetBrains IDEs.
Identify gaps in current developer workflows and define new product directions in the VCS space.
Explore new opportunities, from cross-IDE VCS clients and host-neutral code reviews to AI-native review and authorship tracking.
Listen closely to what the community and the industry are saying to figure out exactly what we should be working on.
Align roadmap decisions across the product, engineering, design, marketing, developer advocacy, partnership, and customer-facing teams.
Work with engineering and quality leads to balance user value, technical constraints, and platform health.
Shape external positioning and represent our VCS direction in conversations with customers and the broader developer tools community.

A collaborative mindset that works well with engineering and quality teams on deeply technical challenges.
Strong product judgment, especially when navigating ambiguous areas to define a new ecosystem.
The ability to think beyond existing boundaries and spot opportunities for entirely new workflows.
Clear communication skills, whether you’re aligning internal stakeholders or talking to deeply technical users.
A data-informed approach, combining usage metrics, customer feedback, and market signals to make decisions.
An interest in how AI is changing software development, from generated commits to AI-assisted reviews.
A drive to improve solutions instead of copying what already exists.
What you’ll need
Previous success leading the product direction and strategy for technically complex developer tools, SCM, CI/CD, or code collaboration software.
The proven ability to translate intricate developer workflows into clear product roadmaps.
Experience bringing stakeholders together across product, engineering, marketing, and developer advocacy.
A deep understanding of version control mechanics, code-change workflows, and how developers actually ship code.
Based in the EU, ideally Munich, Prague, Amsterdam, Berlin, Belgrade, or remote within the EU, with the ability to travel to JetBrains offices as needed.
As a plus, familiarity with advanced version control scenarios, such as complex merges, monorepos, and enterprise/self-hosted setups.
What success looks like
Success means moving VCS from a platform subsystem to a clear, strategic ecosystem. You’ll have built a compelling product vision that engineering teams are aligned on and customers are excited about. You won’t just be copying what exists.

You’ll be finding entirely new ways to solve code-change workflows, especially as AI becomes a bigger part of development. Ultimately, you’ll earn your team's trust by making sound decisions, keeping projects moving, and leaving the product better than you found it.

Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
Relocation support. Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
Free meals and snacks. Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
Health and wellness. On-site gyms or sports club stipends.

Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. What You'll Own
Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.
Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.
Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.
Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.
Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.
Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.
Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.
Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.
Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.
Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.
Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.
High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.
Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.
The Kind of Builder We Want
Starts from user problems, not feature lists.
Can make decisions with incomplete information.
Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.
Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.
Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.
This Role Is Not For
People who only write decks and do not drive execution.
PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.
Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.
People who launch features and then stop caring.
PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Grafana Labs is a remote-first, open-source powerhouse. There are more than 20M users of Grafana, the open source visualization tool, around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps.

The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a NASA launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France.

Grafana Labs also helps more than 3,000 companies -- including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay -- manage their observability strategies with the Grafana LGTM Stack, which can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud or self-managed with the Grafana Enterprise Stack, both featuring scalable metrics (Grafana Mimir), logs (Grafana Loki), and traces (Grafana Tempo).
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Canada EST. About Product Management: As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs , you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain.

You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders.

The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential. Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM.

You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

As the Senior Product Manager for Infrastructure Observability (Infra O11y) you’ll be responsible for our most popular Grafana Cloud products that span the infrastructure suite: Kubernetes Monitoring and Cloud Provider Observability. Infra O11y provides our customers with the ability to easily monitor their core services – from our smallest self-serve customers to our largest enterprise customers.
Your primary responsibility will be to help define the vision and ensure the long-term success of Infra O11y, working with your engineering partners to fine-tune product strategy. You will be charting the path forward for net-new product initiatives – like Host Monitoring – balanced with maintaining a strong roadmap and customer satisfaction for our most mature products.
Your role will require heavy customer discovery, understanding user needs, and building consensus and alignment across several Engineering groups and many stakeholders as we look towards simplifying our broader Infra O11y experience for Grafana Cloud. You will also need to flex your GTM muscles and build conviction in areas like competitive analysis and sales enablement to better inform activities like pricing and packaging.
Beyond driving your individual product area, you’ll also need to ensure that the experiences you’re building are tightly woven into our overall Grafana Cloud suite of products, by establishing integration touchpoints with other key offerings like Grafana Cloud Knowledge Graph and Grafana Assistant, so that our customers have a seamless monitoring experience where they can easily navigate between different layers of their architecture through guided explorations and natural language.

Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering
