Anyone can build AI insurance software now. The models are commoditized. The demos work. Almost nobody starts where Agency Revolution starts: thousands of independent P&C agencies already paying us to communicate with their clients, plus deep integrations into the systems where agency data actually lives.
The opportunity is the relationship layer — the system that notices when an agency's clients are at risk of churning, spots the cross-sell opportunity, picks the right message and channel and moment, and acts. We call it RelationshipOS. For ten years, agencies have trusted us to speak to their clients.

Now we're expanding what we can see: call transcripts, carrier communications, life events. The policies live in the agency's management system. The relationship lives with us. Nobody else has both the permission and the infrastructure.
We know what we're betting on. We don't yet know what makes an agency owner act on it. That's the job.
The strategic thesis is set. What's unresolved is whether it's true — whether an agency will actually change what they do because our system told them to, and what has to be built for that to happen. You're hired to answer that by shipping, not by studying.

s.h: Two halves, and you need both
s.t:
You personally build the bet. The intelligence layer is your work. Discovery with agency owners, prototypes in front of them within days, the smallest version that proves someone will act. Much of this is assembled rather than authored — the right vendor wired into AR Connect and pointed at a real use case will beat anything we could build from scratch this year. You don't hand this half to your team; it's too early and too ambiguous to delegate.
Your team drives the day-to-day execution and health of the existing platform. Two Product Owners and a Product Analyst keep a profitable, decade-old product healthy and improving. You set their priorities, strengthen their product judgment, raise their craft, and shield them from thrash. You remain the primary product manager responsible for the roadmap, discovery, and strategic product decisions. Done well, this is what buys you the time to do the first half.
Most people are good at one of these. We need someone who won't quietly abandon the other.
This position offers $125,000-$140,000 depending on experience and qualifications.

RelationshipOS — the intelligence layer. Churn signals. Cross-sell opportunities. Adaptive customer journeys instead of rigid sequences. You define what "acted on" means, instrument it, and are accountable for the number.
AR Connect and the vendor stack. AR Connect is our integration layer — where APIs pull in calls, carrier communications, life events, and other signals, and where third-party capability plugs into our distribution. It's the substrate the whole thesis sits on, and it's how a promising vendor becomes a live use case in front of agencies.
That work is yours: mapping the landscape of management systems, carrier connections, data enrichment providers, and AI vendors; deciding what we integrate versus build; running the POCs; and getting from "interesting demo" to something an agency actually uses. Data quality, latency, unit economics, and what happens when a vendor's model is wrong are your problems to surface early. You shape the deals and bring the recommendation — the SVP and our partnership team close them.
Voice AI as a channel. Not a feature — a real channel. Define the MVP, run pilots where AI handles outbound outreach with warm handoffs to agencies, and produce the evidence for whether this moves us from subscription toward outcome-based pricing.
The Agency Revolution roadmap. What ships, in what order, and what we stop doing. You own the sequencing and defend it.

Outcomes you'll own
Anova leads customer insight amongst the IoT market. Your deep curiosity about customers, their processes, and how IoT transforms their business will keep Anova the leading player that best understands how IoT leads to value for our customers' customers.
Feature adoption and customer value realization. Features you ship get used, and customers can point to the value. You define the adoption metric before you ship, track it after, and iterate until it moves.

You use AI as leverage. You're fluent with LLMs for research, synthesis, drafting, and analysis, and you bring a clear point of view on where AI should — and shouldn't — show up in B2B industrial products.
You reason from data. You define the metric before you ship the feature, and you're comfortable pulling the numbers yourself in a modern BI tool.

About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

Named #1 best software for small business of 2024 by G2
2,700+ employees in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and Turkiye and growing
Over $500M in annual revenue
The SMB market is large (and growing!) with huge opportunities for Gusto to make an incredible impact for SMBs
There are 6.2M employers in the US, 98% have fewer than 100 employees (1)

s.h: What Product Management is like at Gusto
s.t:
Our Product team is lean, which means you’ll have a high degree of impact and ownership. We believe in smaller, empowered teams that move quickly with less overhead. You’ll move fast by pairing sharp product judgment with fluency in AI tools automating what slows teams down and amplifying what makes them creative and high-performing.
We’re boundaryless builders. Lines between roles are intentionally blurred, and our PMs do whatever it takes to deliver outcomes. You’ll prototype, automate, design, and ship using AI as your co-builder to turn problems into durable solutions that deliver customer value with urgency and care.
We’re here to serve small and medium businesses. Gusto has a strong mission-driven culture, and we care deeply about lifting up these business owners building technology for an AI-first world that gives them the superpowers to run and grow their businesses with confidence.
We’re comfortable with change. Our environment moves fast, and PMs here thrive in ambiguity blending curiosity, experimentation, and AI-native craft to shape how products (and work itself) are built at Gusto.

CoreX AI builds and powers AI experiences that make Gusto the best teammate for small businesses. Our largest AI bets embed directly in small business workflows whether that's answering a quick question or handling the task itself. Our customers trust us with their payroll, their employees' benefits, and their money decisions where mistakes have real, immediate consequences. We give small businesses trusted and powerful AI tools that supercharge how they work.
We're at an inflection point across everything we own, and we're looking for a product leader ready to accelerate our AI bets as we build toward that future. This is a role for builders who can work across Gusto, reason about API design and model behavior as comfortably as customer experience, and bring hands-on experience building with AI.

You'll define how Gusto's conversational assistant works, behaves, and earns customer trust and how small businesses use it to get real work done across payroll, benefits, HR, and beyond.
Develop a deep understanding of how small businesses actually work inside Gusto today the workflows they run, where they get stuck, and the work they'd hand off if they could
Lead the product vision for Gusto’s conversational assistant that gives small businesses superpowers, and turn it into a coherent strategy a sharp perspective on where the assistant earns real value, and what we build first
Expand what the assistant can actually do. You'll partner with domain teams to grow tool and domain coverage across payroll, time, benefits, and compliance, and hold the bar on quality as coverage grows measured in real actions customers complete, not conversations they have
Define how we show up in our customers’ ecosystem and the surfaces where work naturally happens third-party connectors, messaging channels, and AI clients and decide what earns priority against the depth we have in the app
Partner with engineering and data teams on technical trade-offs: how we expose Gusto's capabilities to agents through our API and MCP layer, how the assistant embeds into our first-party surfaces, and where we take on debt to move faster
Partner with design and UXR to understand how customers actually feel about AI acting on their behalf, and use that to shape how we build
Move fast. Speed is our top priority, and you'll set a pace that reflects it shipping narrow slices that get customers value early rather than waiting on the complete build

10+ years building as a product manager, with experience owning meaningful scope and driving broad product or platform-level decisions
You're comfortable in a high-visibility role engaging directly with Gusto leadership and product leaders across the company, and driving decisions that stick
You believe in what AI can do for small businesses, and you're excited to build it.
You understand what it takes to build trusted AI products: writing evals, holding a real point of view on AI quality, and assuming the responsibility of a product customers rely on day-to-day
You're hands-on and you'd rather build than delegate — and you thrive in a culture that expects it
You’re comfortable spanning both platform thinking and UX/experience judgment within the same role
You develop sharp perspectives on the systems AI products need — RAG, ontology, and a scalable API strategy for agent-accessible systems
You’re comfortable with a fluid, expanding charter. This isn't a role with a static roadmap, given how fast AI development and the competitive landscape are moving.
Our cash compensation amount for this role is $179,000,000/yr to $220,000/yr in Denver & most major metro locations, and $210,000/yr to $260,000/yr for San Francisco, Seattle & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.
Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.
Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.
When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.
Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

Who Are We?
Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
The Opportunity
Postman is the world's leading API platform and an AI-native developer companion that sits inside the daily workflow of more than 45 million developers and 500,000 organizations. The core product is where nearly all of them meet us: the request they send, the collection they share, the workspace their team lives in, the agent they hand work to. It is the most-used developer surface in the industry. In an AI-first world, almost every assumption behind it is up for renegotiation.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the Postman Product Team to build Postman's product experience.

You will own product initiatives end-to-end, from build to driving adoption across all segments. You will be critical in owning the GTM launch, customer deployments, competitive benchmarking, and success of multiple products.

Build and prototype. We believe in prototypes over documents. You will build product prototypes, not just write documents. Use your technical skills to shorten the distance between an idea and evidence, and get functionality in front of users as early as possible.
Live in the customer's workflow. Run on-site visits, customer deployments, and continuous feedback loops. Turn what you learn into clear feature sets, and into insight the rest of the company can act on.
Win the market. Define what it takes to win the market, and continuously evaluate and remove complexity in the product experience, using data, customer insights, and hands-on experience.
Own the launch, not just the release. Lead beta pitches for the first ~20 customers, then synthesize their feedback into tested, repeatable sales plays. Keep website pages, docs, and blog posts up to date, and partner with PMM on enablement.
Answer for your product in public. Handle questions authoritatively in support channels, internal and external. Be the voice for the product.
Close the loop. Aggressively feed what you learn in market back into the next build cycle.

6+ years of product management experience, including a product used at scale by developers, with a proven track record across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science
Real technical depth: 3+ years building software, or equivalent hands-on ability to read the code, open a PR, and build a functional prototype (React, Node.js, or similar).
Fluency in API technologies and developer workflows (Postman, GitHub, CI/CD, API gateways) and in specification formats such as OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, and Protobuf (gRPC).
Experience shipping AI-enabled developer tools, and a considered point of view on how to evaluate whether they are actually good.
Excellent analytical instincts and comfort with product analytics.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences and articulate a product vision people can repeat back to you.
Mission-oriented, comfortable with change and ambiguity, with an adept ability to ruthlessly prioritize, move fast, and test and iterate quickly.
The reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $200,000 to $230,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.
What Else?
In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend.

Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about.

We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year.

We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
Equal opportunity

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar
Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina . Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram , criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.
Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal , reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões .
Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.
Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.
Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/
Localização e Modelo de Trabalho
Nosso time atua no modelo híbrido , unindo a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto com a troca do presencial no nosso escritório em São Paulo, 1 vez por semana.
Sobre a Área e o Desafio
A área de Collections & Evictions (C&E) é composta pelas operações de cobrança interna e externa (BPO), arbitragem e desocupações judiciais, estruturas fundamentais para o crescimento sustentável da companhia. Estamos em um momento de expansão: a empresa está lançando novos produtos que vão gerar novas frentes de inadimplência, e precisamos estruturar do zero as operações de recuperação de crédito associadas a eles.
Esta posição reporta diretamente ao Head de Recuperação (C&E) e tem como missão principal apoiar o mapeamento, entendimento e aprofundamento técnico de cada novo produto lançado pela companhia, traduzindo esse entendimento em estrutura, processos e desenho operacional de cobrança/recuperação de crédito.
Diferente de uma posição focada na gestão do dia a dia de uma operação já madura, este é um perfil analítico e estratégico, com visão sistêmica e processual completa, capaz de identificar pontos falhos, lacunas e o melhor desenho funcional para garantir que o nascimento de cada nova operação aconteça de forma organizada, eficiente e escalável, combinando processos humanos com ferramentas e agentes de IA (operação híbrida).
Suas Responsabilidades
Mapear e aprofundar o entendimento técnico de cada novo produto lançado pela companhia, identificando como e onde ele gera inadimplência e risco de crédito.
Propor a estrutura, os processos e o desenho funcional da operação de cobrança/recuperação para cada novo produto, do zero, com foco em organização e escalabilidade.
Sinalizar riscos operacionais, de processo e de crédito de forma proativa, antecipando problemas antes do lançamento ou durante a maturação do produto.
Realizar alinhamentos estratégicos com múltiplos stakeholders (Produto, Engenharia, Legal, Prevenção a Fraudes, Finance, FP&A, Controladoria, Projetos , Planning & Performance) para garantir que a operação nasça integrada aos objetivos do negócio.
Desenhar operações híbridas, combinando processos humanos e agentes de IA, sempre priorizando eficiência, menor custo e maior recuperação.
Construir e manter dashboards e análises de causa-raiz em parceria com Planning & Performance, monitorando a efetividade das novas operações desde o dia 1.
Propor e executar planos de ação a partir dos outputs das análises e dos riscos identificados.
Gerenciar equipes internas de cobrança e operações de BPO quando aplicável, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da companhia.
Definir KPIs, rituais de gestão e roadmap de avanços tecnológicos em parceria com Produto e Tecnologia.
Identificar tendências de mercado e aplicar as melhores práticas de cobrança e recuperação de crédito ao desenho das novas operações.
Fornecer feedback estruturado e contínuo para o desenvolvimento da equipe sob sua liderança, quando aplicável.
O que buscamos (Requisitos)
Graduação em Administração, Engenharia, Finanças, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
Experiência em liderança/gestão de operações de cobrança e recuperação de crédito.
Experiência com desenho ou estruturação de processos e operações (preferencialmente em contextos de novos produtos, novas frentes de negócio ou operações do zero).
Experiência com gestão de BPOs é um diferencial.
Conhecimento em indicadores e ferramentas de cobrança (discadores, canais digitais, agentes de IA, etc.).
Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, influência e construção de relacionamento com stakeholders executivos.
Perfil analítico, com facilidade para construir e interpretar análises de dados.
Como é nosso processo seletivo?
Desenhamos uma jornada transparente, direta e focada em avaliar seu potencial técnico, comportamental e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e trilhas de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:
Triagem;
Entrevista People;
Entrevista Hiring Manager;
Case;
Entrevista Stakeholder 1;
Entrevista Stakeholder 2;
Offer.
Importante: Avaliamos todas as candidaturas individualmente e garantimos retorno para todas as pessoas. Toda a comunicação é feita por e-mail, então certifique-se de liberar o domínio @quintoandar.com.br na sua caixa de entrada.

Bnberry is transforming the $87 billion travel tech industry by changing how hotels and resorts connect with guests worldwide. We’re building DBS — a new kind of product that hotels adopt as a B2B SaaS business tool, and that travelers experience directly as a consumer-facing hotel booking journey.
This is not a Product Owner or delivery-management role focused on writing tickets and managing developers. Your mandate is to own DBS end-to-end, connecting three product areas that most companies keep separate: the guest-facing booking experience, the hotel-facing workflows and business value, and how travelers discover hotels through search and AI tools.
What You’ll Own
The consumer-facing booking journey — including the logic behind it: availability, rates, cancellation policies, and how PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations shape what the guest sees
Hotel-facing workflows tied to DBS: onboarding, reporting, and adoption
The product capabilities that help hotels improve and measure visibility across search engines and AI discovery tools, in partnership with Marketing and relevant specialists
Booking-funnel performance and conversion
The link between guest experience and measurable hotel business value

Define product vision and roadmap for DBS, connecting guest booking UX, hotel workflows, and AI discovery into one coherent product
Own the booking journey end-to-end — identify friction in calendars, date selection, room/rate selection, checkout, and confirmation, and understand how availability, rates, cancellation policies, and PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations affect what the guest experiences; work with Engineering on dependencies and failure cases
Translate hotel onboarding, reporting, and adoption needs into product decisions that show measurable business value to hotel customers
Own the product capabilities behind search and AI/GEO visibility — partner with Marketing and relevant specialists on execution, while building enough SEO/GEO literacy to identify and prioritize the right product bets
Interview hoteliers and travelers and run usability tests; translate qualitative and quantitative findings into clear priorities
Define success metrics before building, and use experiment results to guide iteration
Work closely with Design and Engineering through detailed user journeys, making trade-offs and shipping in small, practical iterations
Align Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success around DBS priorities, and take responsibility for product outcomes

3+ years of product management experience owning customer-facing products, including relevant experience in hospitality technology or travel booking
Relevant, demonstrable connection to the US market
Hands-on customer research skills — hotelier and traveler interviews, usability testing, and translating findings into clear priorities
Strong analytical and experimentation skills — diagnosing booking-funnel friction, testing improvements, and measuring booking conversion, hotel adoption, and retention
Comfortable working through detailed user journeys with Design and Engineering, making trade-offs, and shipping in small iterations
Able to operate independently with ambiguity, prioritize by customer and business value, and align Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success

Industry-Grounded — You’ve worked in hotel technology, B2B hospitality platforms, or a B2C travel product with an actual booking journey. Deep exposure to hotel distribution systems is a plus, not a prerequisite — strong B2C travel/booking experience counts too.
US Market Fluent — You have demonstrable familiarity with US hotels or travel customers, whether through working with them directly or through living and studying in the US combined with hospitality experience.
Booking UX Owner — You understand the details of a booking flow — calendars, date selection, room and rate choice, checkout, confirmation — and the logic behind it: availability, rates, cancellation policies, and PMS/CRS or booking-engine integrations. You can spot friction before a customer complains about it.
Fluent in Both Guest and Hotel — You’re as comfortable reasoning about a traveler’s booking journey as you are about a hotelier’s onboarding, adoption, and ROI.
Fast Learner on AI/SEO — You understand how travelers discover hotels through search and AI tools, and can pick up emerging SEO/GEO capabilities quickly enough to know which product bets are worth making — without needing to personally execute SEO.
Success Metrics
Examples include: booking conversion rate, hotel adoption of DBS, feature adoption, booking-funnel completion, search and AI/GEO visibility for hotels on DBS, customer and hotelier satisfaction, and retention.
Important Clarification
This role is not a traditional Product Owner responsible primarily for backlog management and task assignment. The focus is on owning DBS as a genuinely new product category — one that has to work as a business tool for hotels and as a booking experience travelers actually use.

Define a new product category — DBS sits at the intersection of B2B SaaS, consumer booking, and AI discovery, largely undefined by competitors today
Autonomy to experiment, take risks, and drive discovery

HelloFresh's Onboarding squad owns the highest-leverage window in the customer lifecycle: from the moment a prospect converts to the moment they become a settled, loyal customer. Onboarding is the connective tissue that links the conversion funnel to long-term customer value.
We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead the Onboarding squad and define the product vision for how HelloFresh guides new customers from their first delivery into habitual, high-value subscription. You will own the end-to-end early customer experience across web and app — spanning post-checkout confirmation, subscription management, digital engagement, and the critical Box 1→2→3 progression — across all HelloFresh Group brands, including Factor.
The defining product challenge ahead is building and scaling the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: an ML-powered, segment-aware system that identifies the right action for each customer at each moment in their early lifecycle and delivers it seamlessly across web and app surfaces. This is a genuine 0-to-1 build — one that requires both strategic vision and hands-on execution.
This role demands a PM who is obsessed with solving customer pain points and equally obsessed with the cross-squad collaboration required to do it at scale. Onboarding does not sit inside a single product surface — it spans the activation funnel, CRM and lifecycle communications, app and engagement experiences, and Data Science.

The PM leading this squad must be a hyper-collaborator: capable of aligning diverse stakeholders across squads and tribes and bringing coherence to an experience that crosses many surfaces and teams.

Own the product vision and strategy for the end-to-end Onboarding experience across all HelloFresh Group brands — from post-checkout confirmation to Settled Conversion (3 boxes in 4 weeks).
Lead the build and scaling of the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: a segment-aware, state-aware personalisation system that dynamically surfaces the right customer action at the right moment across web and app.
Drive measurable improvement in Settled Conversion rate through a high-velocity experimentation roadmap.
Own the full-surface onboarding experience — welcome dashboard, subscription management, meal selection flows, app onboarding layer, and CRM-triggered touchpoints — ensuring coherence and quality across every channel and surface.
Partner with Data Science and Engineering to define the data and ML foundations that power personalised, segment-aware onboarding at scale.
Act as the connective tissue between squads and tribes: align the Activation funnel squad, CRM and Communications tribe, and App and Engagement team around a unified onboarding strategy and shared north-star metrics.
Build deep consumer empathy through qualitative research, quantitative funnel analysis, and direct customer engagement — and bring the early customer voice into every product decision.
Define and own success metrics for Onboarding — Settled Conversion rate, Box 1→2 and 2→3 conversion, app adoption rate, and unwanted box rate — and hold yourself and the squad accountable to them.
Own BAU operations: triage funnel issues rapidly, maintain onboarding health monitoring, and serve as the escalation point for anything threatening early retention performance.
Drive cross-functional alignment as a single-threaded leader across global tribes and alliances — creating clarity and shared direction needed for the squad to ship at velocity.

Customer Lifecycle & Early Retention Expertise: A deep understanding of subscription customer lifecycle dynamics — churn triggers, early retention levers, and the interplay between product experience and commercial outcomes. You think in journeys, not screens, and you can translate moments of friction or delight into business impact across the Box 0→3 window.
Cross-Surface Product Leadership: Proven experience owning end-to-end product experiences that span web and native app — including the architectural and strategic choices that come with maintaining coherence across channels. You understand how in-product engagement, push notifications, CRM communications, and app surfaces form a single connected customer journey.
Growth Experimentation at Scale: 6+ years of PM experience at Senior or Staff level, with hands-on expertise running structured growth experiments — A/B and multivariate testing, holdout groups — in consumer subscription products. You know how to design rigorous experiments, interpret results with nuance, and compound learnings into a strategic roadmap.
Hyper-Collaborative Leadership: Exceptional ability to operate across squad and tribe boundaries — aligning Engineering, CRM, Data Science, Design, and Marketing around a shared goal without direct authority. You create clarity in complexity and sustain alignment across a large, distributed organisation.
Data and ML Product Fluency: Comfortable partnering with Data Science to define and govern ML-powered personalisation systems. You do not need to write the models, but you can write the spec, challenge the approach, and translate model outputs into precise product decisions.
0-to-1 Build Pedigree: Proven experience taking complex, ambiguous product problems and turning them into shipped product at scale — from initial vision through delivery. You have led large-scale, end-to-end launches and know how to orchestrate cross-functional work under uncertainty.
Consumer Empathy & Insight-Driven Thinking: You combine qualitative empathy with quantitative rigour. You are as comfortable in a customer interview or usability session as in a funnel analytics deep-dive, and you consistently work backwards from user needs to define what to build.
High Agency & Ownership Mindset: You do not wait to be told what to do. You diagnose, decide, and drive. You are energised by ambiguity, take genuine accountability for outcomes rather than outputs, and raise the bar on the team around you.

s.t:
This is a rare 0-to-1 opportunity to build a brand-new, high-visibility capability that touches every Okta customer: backup and recovery to strengthen the resilience of our system. You’ll be responsible for building a modern, self-service experience that allows IT Admins to recover back their accidentally or maliciously deleted identity objects.

You'll partner closely with Engineering, Field, Pricing & Packaging, and Product leadership to shape a capability with direct, measurable impact on customer retention and revenue growth.

Contribute to the long-term product vision and strategy for Okta's resilience strategy, ensuring the backup and recovery roadmap scales with the breadth of Okta's customer base and product portfolio.
Design a self-service recovery center to ensure customers can seamlessly and securely track their deletions and changes and revert back across the entire Okta ecosystem.
Collaborat e with India-based engineering and development scrum teams to deliver high-performance, scalable backup and recovery solution
Distill complex requirements from a diverse stakeholder group - including Field (AE/CSM), Pricing & Packaging, Support, Design, and Product teams - into precise technical specifications.
Analyze how large-scale enterprise customer’s resilience needs to identify friction points and drive improvements in customer trust and platform experience.
Validate assumptions at low cost by building compelling hypotheses and designing rigorous experiments before committing to major infrastructure investments.

3+ years of Product Management experience specifically within enterprise-scale SaaS platforms or core software infrastructure.
BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering , or equivalent technical experience that enables you to rationalize and influence complex architectural decisions.
Proven ability to produce solid, actionable plans from incomplete, conflicting, or highly ambiguous inputs.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills , with a track record of successfully collaborating across global functions and time zones.
Demonstrated business results from customer-facing platform capabilities shipped at scale.

Experience with Backup or recovery tools
Deep familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) protocols and security standards.
Experience partnering with Sales/CSM organizations on customer-facing solution positioning
Advanced degree in a technical or business field (e.g., MS in a technical discipline or an MBA).

Die BWT Schweiz, bestehend aus den Unternehmen BWT AQUA AG und BWT AQUA Pharma \& Biotech AG, hat ihren Hauptsitz in Aesch BL und beschäftigt rund 500 Mitarbeitende. Beide Unternehmen sind Teil der BWT\-Gruppe. BWT ist Europas führendes Wasseraufbereitungsunternehmen mit mehr als 80 Tochter\- und Beteiligungsgesellschaften und über 6500 Mitarbeitenden weltweit.
BWT hat es sich zur Aufgabe gemacht, Wassertechnologien zu entwickeln, zu produzieren und zu vermarkten, die den Menschen eine bessere Lebensqualität bieten. Der Industrie werden ökonomisch sowie ökologisch sinnvolle Lösungen in der Wasseraufbereitung zur Verfügung gestellt.
Unser Portfolio an Technologien und Produkten deckt vom Wassereingang bis zum Verbraucher alle Bereiche der Wasseraufbereitung ab. In unseren Hauptbereichen Wasseraufbereitung für Industrie, Gewerbe und Private, Reinstwasser und Trinkwasserspender sorgen wir für perfektes Wasser im täglichen Leben. Abgerundet wird unser Angebot durch einen umfassenden Service.
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams **im Produktmanagement in der BWT AQUA AG** suchen wir dich als:
**Produktmanager Ionenaustauscher \& Umkehrosmosenanlagen 100% (alle)**
***"Wir können alles \- ausser langweilig"***
**Diese spannenden und interessanten Aufgaben warten auf dich:**
* Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung für das Produktportfolio Ionenaustauscher und Umkehrosmoseanlagen für die Anwendungsgebiete Trinkwasser, Gastronomie, Unternehmen und Spitäler, Gebäude und Industrie sowie Beleuchtungstechnik.
* Du managst und optimierst das Portfolio über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg.
* Gemeinsam mit unserem Verkaufsteam entwickelst du verkaufsfördernde Massnahmen.
* Mit unserem Marketingteam erarbeitest du passgenaue Inhalte für die entsprechenden Kanäle.

**Diese Eigenschaften zeichnen dich aus:**
* Du hast eine technische Ausbildung oder ein Studium im Bereich Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Elektromechanik oder in einer ähnlichen Fachrichtung und verfügst idealerweise bereits über entsprechende Berufserfahrung.
* Du verfügst über betriebswirtschaftliche und Marketingkenntnisse.
* Erfahrung in der Wasseraufbereitung und Verfahrenstechnik ist von Vorteil.
* Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder im technischen Verkauf von Industriegütern ist von Vorteil.
* Du begeisterst dich für wassertechnische Produkte in einer zukunftsorientierten Branche.
* Du arbeitest selbstständig, zuverlässig und genau und bist gleichzeitig ein echter Teamplayer.
* Vertriebsorientiertes Denken und Handeln sind für dich selbstverständlich.
* Weiterbildungen im Produktmanagement sind ein Plus.

* Ausdauer, Kommunikationsstärke und die nötige Portion Durchsetzungsvermögen.
* Eine analytische und systematische Arbeitsweise mit einem klaren Blick für Lösungen Offenheit für Neues.

Es erwartet Dich eine interessante und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem lebhaften und kollegialen Arbeitsumfeld, welches Flexibilität und Selbstständigkeit erfordert. Du wirst dabei von einem erfahrenen und langjährigen Team unterstützt.

Die BWT AQUA AG hat eine flache Hierarchie und legt grossen Wert auf ein familiäres und angenehmes Zusammenarbeiten. Es besteht eine Du\-Kultur bis in die oberste Führungsebene. Dank unseren Werten dürfen wir auf viele langjährige Arbeitskolleginnen und Kollegen zählen.

* Firmeneigene Kantine

Product Strategy & Vision
Own and drive the roadmap for new structured market analytics products, prioritizing investments based on user needs, market opportunity, and fit with the broader platform.
Develop a deep understanding of healthcare markets and the data that describes them—including claims, provider, utilization, and market share data—and how consultants and clients use analytics to answer market questions.
Translate ambiguous business questions into well-defined product requirements with clear metric definitions, data specifications, and acceptance criteria.
Define and track success metrics for each product, including accuracy, adoption, and usage.
Agentic Analytics Product Development
Lead end-to-end development of new standardized market analytics products: data source evaluation, data model and metric design, validation, and release.
Partner with data engineers and analysts on schema design, transformation logic, and data quality assurance.
Build and own accuracy benchmarks and testing frameworks, including gold-standard test sets that gate each release.
Ensure products are designed for consumption by AI agents and downstream applications, not just human analysts.
Execution & Leadership
Drive product execution from requirements through delivery, including documentation, backlog management, and release communication.
Communicate options and trade-offs to senior leaders to enable fast, well-informed decisions.
Gather structured feedback from consultants and clients, and iterate on products based on real-world usage.
Serve as the connective tissue across product, data, and consulting teams to ensure analytics products evolve in ways that serve the full portfolio.

5+ years of experience in product management, analytics, or data product roles, with demonstrated success delivering data-intensive products
Deep analytics expertise, including SQL, data modeling, metric definition, and hands-on work with large datasets
Healthcare background, with working knowledge of healthcare data (such as claims, provider, and market data) and industry dynamics across providers and payers
Experience building and managing data products on cloud data platforms required, with Snowflake strongly preferred
Consulting experience preferred, with an understanding of how advisory teams use data and analytics in client work
Proven ability to define the right metrics, use data to drive decisions, and deliver measurable outcomes
Demonstrated success taking products from concept to pilot to scale in ambiguous, early-stage environments
Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical teams and business stakeholders
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in a technical or quantitative field a plus
Salary range: $135,000- $201,000 plus may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus.

The salary range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to, skills, experience, training, licensure and certifications, practice area, and other business and organizational needs.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.
Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.
Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.
You will own our enterprise product: the roadmap for what large customers need, and the control plane that makes it possible. These are the capabilities that decide whether a large customer can adopt us, trust us, and expand with us.
Our product is an API, and our enterprise buyer is an engineering organization. The people you build for are platform teams, architects, and the developers inside those companies who are putting agents into production. You need to be comfortable making product decisions about API surfaces, developer workflows, and technical tradeoffs, not only about business requirements.
To build this well, you have to be in the room. You will work alongside customer success, sales, and our forward-deployed engineers, who are in these accounts every week and already know where we fall short, and you will spend real time with customers alongside them. Delivery and implementation stay with forward-deployed engineering and go-to-market. Your job is to turn what you learn into product.
The hard part is judgment. Knowing which request is one account's edge case, and which one is the thing every enterprise customer will ask for six months from now. Getting that right is the difference between a platform and a pile of custom work.
In your first year, we expect you to own a clear enterprise roadmap, ship the controls that block deals today, and become the person the go-to-market team comes to before a deal gets stuck.
This is a hands-on senior IC role with real ownership, reporting to the Director of Product. The product team is small, so you will work directly with the engineers building your roadmap and with the go-to-market teams selling it.

Own the enterprise roadmap: what we build for large customers, in what order, and why.
Own the platform behind it: organizations and identity, keys and quotas, spend controls, usage observability and audit, policy enforcement, and data residency.
Make product decisions on our API surface for enterprise use, so that the developers inside those accounts can build on us without friction.
Work with customer success, sales, and forward-deployed engineering to understand what enterprise customers need, and spend time in accounts alongside them to see it first hand.
Tell the difference between a single-account request and a pattern worth building for, and be able to defend the call either way.
Hand off what belongs to another product area, with the evidence that makes it actionable.
Give sales and marketing the positioning, materials, and product understanding they need to sell a technical product well.
Represent enterprise customers in roadmap decisions with evidence rather than anecdote.
We expect you to have
6+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful part of it spent on enterprise products in B2B, developer platform, or API businesses.
Experience building developer-facing or API products, with real understanding of what makes an API good to build against.
Experience building platform capabilities that enterprises depend on, such as identity, permissions, quotas, usage controls, audit, or compliance.
A track record of working with large enterprise accounts, including recognized logos, and turning what you learned into shipped product.
Credibility with technical buyers: platform teams, architects, security, and procurement.
Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval fit into agentic workflows. Hands-on technical background is a strong plus.
The ability to turn many messy customer conversations into one clear, prioritized product argument.
Proven ability to drive alignment without formal authority, including with product owners who do not report to you.
It will be a bonus if you have
Background as a forward-deployed engineer, solutions engineer, or solutions architect before moving into product.
Experience in search, information retrieval, or NLP.
Experience in API-first businesses running both self-serve and enterprise motions.
Experience building for regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, or healthcare.

Product

Do you want to solve the hardest problem when it comes to moving money globally supporting SMEs thriving with their international businesses? Do you want to be part of an ambitious team that wants to democratize access to currencies and corridors to all Businesses and Entrepreneurs?
If you are result oriented, a problem solver hungry for learning more, then Ebury is the place for you!
We are seeking an experienced and strategically-minded Product Manager to support the continuous growth of our Money Flows platform with new products, features, and even greater access to corridors and currencies. You will support the vision, strategy and execution of a domain within Money Flows going from ideation to execution.

Product Vision & Strategy
You will own and drive the execution of a key product area within Money Flow, from the why and the what to the how
You will ensure alignment with the long-term product vision balancing feature development, technical debt, and experimentation
You will present market and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and threats within your specific product domain
Execution & Delivery
You will be in charge of the product backlog for your area and you will be directly responsible for achieving defined success metrics
You will translate regulatory changes or rulebooks to actual money flows
Engineering will be your key stakeholder
You will ensure timely and highest quality delivery through the full development cycle
Networks and payment schemes are second nature to you. You will be fluent in any of the following: SWIFT, SEPA, FPS APIs implementation. Payment flows, whether on corresponding banking or cards or schemes, are core part of the experiences you bring to the table
You will regularly gather feedback from clients, translating needs, and opportunities into clear requirements so that our clients’ money moves as smooth as possible
You will run your Shows&Tell, communicating feature updates, product decisions, and trade-offs
You will be the go-to person for your product, proactively resolving queries and providing clarity to the any stakeholder
You are comfortable with product's architecture and you have a solid understanding of technology stack
Be able to speak to technical constraints that impact product development
Leadership & People Development
You will drive and own day-to-day decision-making within your focussed area with minimal supervision
You will help onboarding and mentoring new or junior members on processes, product and payment contexts
What you’ll need
This role requires a unique combination of technical product leadership and deep domain expertise, often gained through top-tier consulting or banking roles.
Consulting Experience: Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in Accenture or Big4, specifically working on financial services or payments transformation project
Banking/Financial Services Domain: Minimum of 2 years experience in Fintech or Bank working in the payment chain OR
Product Management: Minimum of 2 years in Product for a Fintech successfully launching and scaling complex, regulated financial products

We power people’s progress.
At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.
We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.
Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.
As a product team, our goal is to improve the life of our students and our tutors, drive amazing learning outcomes for our learners and enable our tutors to financially thrive through the platform. And we want to do this all while generating business value for Preply so we can help even more people! We strongly believe that we can't achieve business success without our students' and tutors' success.
Preply is a product led company. As part of the product team, you will have a direct impact on the company's growth and strategy with high visibility to our C-suite and leadership team. You will be empowered to operate independently with a dedicated cross functional team to build amazing products and take them from inception to launch to scale!
With great power comes great responsibility. Our product managers have true end-to-end accountability for their area with varied areas of responsibility such as: setting the long term vision and strategy for the squad, conceptualizing the product(s), driving the daily execution with the team, launching and analyzing the impact of your product on our customers.

Preply is one of the largest advertisers in the Education Tech space. Our marketing operations span dozens of languages, thousands of creatives, and multiple acquisition channels. To keep growing at this scale, we need world-class products that take marketing channels to levels of performance impossible to reach manually.
As the Senior Product Manager for MarTech Scale, you'll own the products that scale Preply's marketing channels far beyond what manual effort allows - across Paid Search, SEO, AI Search, Display (Meta, TikTok, etc.), Affiliates, and the next wave of channels yet to emerge.
You'll partner with engineering, data, and marketing teams to build products that efficiently drive new subscribers to Preply at unprecedented scale.

Scale paid acquisition channels through Product
Own the SEM platform that posts and optimises millions of keywords - from discovery, through bidding, account structure, and ad copy generation. Push the team toward an always-on, data-driven automated scale of operations.
Build creative automation for Display channels - generating, tracking, testing and iterating on creatives, across dozens of languages and regions.
Build channel-management products for Display and Affiliates - automating bidding, account structure, partner onboarding, and reporting so the team can run dozens of campaigns and partners as one.
Partner with channel owners to identify the next leverage point - a new bidding model, account architecture, or feed strategy - and turn it into a Product.
Identify and build new acquisition channels (e.g., OpenAI Apps) before competitors do.
Power organic and AI Search with a limitless page-creation engine
Lead the product behind a step-change in SEO scale, with a system that takes keyword opportunities and produces high-quality pages, at scale.
Shape Preply's positioning in AI Search as discovery shifts from blue links to LLM answers - defining the content, structure, and signals that win on this new surface.
Continuously evolve the page-creation engine to stay ahead of evolving search behaviour, ranking systems, and AI search tools.
Make landing pages a conversion advantage
Own the Preply homepage, and the platform that powers bespoke landing pages across marketing channels. Deeply understand users’ intents from different marketing channels and match that to their landing experience.
Partner with the broader Growth Tribe to optimize the top of the funnel end-to-end - carrying marketing intent across the full conversion journey, not just the landing page.
Run a fast cycle of hypothesis, experiment, learning across geographies, audiences, and channels.
Make Preply Marketing AI-native
Make AI a first-class building block in the platforms you ship. From keyword and ad copy generation, to page creation, to creative automation - AI is the engine that makes scale possible. Architect for it from day one rather than retrofitting it later.
Be the standard-bearer for AI inside the Marketing org - proactively identifying where AI compounds marketer output and be hands-on building solutions.
Build the platform and guardrails that let every marketer at Preply operate with AI safely and effectively in their daily work.
Stay close to the frontier of AI capabilities, and translate what's possible into what's worth shipping.

Lead with vision: Stay at the forefront of marketing technology, growth, and AI innovation. Anticipate industry shifts - from how AI is reshaping search behaviour to emerging acquisition surfaces - and translate them into a clear, long-term MarTech Scale strategy for Preply.
Be a domain authority: Inspire your squad and cross-functional partners by articulating a bold vision for how Tech can scale marketing channels far beyond what's possible today.
Go deep into the system: Own the platform at the depth of an engineer. Query the tables yourself, read the data pipelines, design the architecture alongside the team. Open the marketing platforms (Google Ads, Meta, GSC) and see the performance with your own eyes. The best decisions in MarTech come from PMs who understand the system as well as the people building it.
Own end-to-end outcomes: Take full ownership of the product lifecycle - from defining platform requirements and architectural choices to driving execution, adoption, and measurable business impact.
Be biased for action: Balance strategy and developing conviction with quick and lean hypothesis testing to launch MVPs and iterate based on results. Open the marketing platforms and see the performance with your own eyes.
Make decisions through data: Use data to evaluate the impact of platform changes on marketing efficiency, scale, and growth.
Be a cross-functional force multiplier: Partner deeply with Marketing, Data, and Engineering teams - sharing ownership of KPIs and building trust through transparency and collaboration. Foster a culture where automation and AI enable every marketer at Preply to operate at their full potential.
At least five years of hands-on technical experience in Performance Marketing channel management for a highly-trafficked consumer website OR experience as a product manager in marketing technology.

You will lead the modernization of our marketing data platform and drive the integration of artificial intelligence across our data products. Operating independently, you will bridge the gap between complex engineering systems and business needs, ensuring our foundational architecture supports sophisticated data science and analytics. Your focus will remain on dismantling data silos and replacing legacy frameworks with highly scalable, real-time data solutions.
Your impact will be felt globally as you collaborate with commercial stakeholders to translate business strategies into actionable, deliverable requirements. As a Senior Product Manager in Banking Experience, you will own the reconciliation review experience, the human layer that sits on top of Auto Bank Rec (ABR), one of the biggest Xero product launches last year.

ABR uses AI to automatically reconcile bank transactions for small businesses and accountants, and as we invest further in automating that work, the review experience becomes the critical part: it lets customers trust the automation and move to a healthy reconciliation state faster.

You will drive time-to-value, the core metric for our global banking suite, by pushing this experience from today's manual checks toward true management by exception where routine reconciliation happens automatically and people only step in for what genuinely needs their judgement.
You will step into a pivotal, high-visibility space, balancing product strategy with practical execution.

Moving between big-picture and technical implementation, you will work closely with engineering, machine learning, and cross-functional partners, including defining how we evaluate model quality as automation expands to turn product ambiguity into clear, actionable roadmaps that extend bank rec beyond its current form into a more conversational, AI-native experience across the surfaces customers actually work in.
This role is based in New Zealand working as part of a globally distributed banking organization.

You will join a collaborative team of Product Managers in NZ who lead different facets of our banking experience, alongside a broader distributed organization. The team works seamlessly with dedicated engineering pods, user experience designers, and cross-functional stakeholders across global time zones. Together, you will foster an open environment where data-driven ideas are shared, tested, and transformed into impactful software solutions.
Initially you will focus on
Ramping up on the current state of Auto Bank Rec and the reconciliation review experience to establish a prioritised near-term roadmap.
Partnering with engineering teams to push the management-by-exception model further, reducing what customers need to check by hand.
Defining key success metrics, eval frameworks, and dashboards to track quality, review effort, and time-to-value as automation scales.
Establishing clear, consensus-driven product requirements alongside design and engineering partners for expanding reconciliation into new, AI-native surfaces.

Lead Product Manager – Payments Risk
Our Purpose
At Xero, we’re here to supercharge small businesses. By making small business more efficient every day, connecting them with big business technology and empowering a community behind them, their potential is limitless. When that happens, we’re not only helping small business, we’ll be building a stronger economy that can change the world.
How you’ll make an impact
As a Lead Product Manager – Payments Risk, you’ll build the risk capabilities that enable Xero customers to accept payments securely, reliably and with as little unnecessary friction as possible.

s.h: You’ll own product strategy and execution across two core areas
s.t:
Merchant risk — including KYB/KYC, merchant eligibility, underwriting, risk segmentation, financial exposure management and ongoing merchant monitoring.
Transaction risk — including fraud detection and decisioning, transaction monitoring, disputes and chargebacks, reserves and holds, payout risk and payments loss management.
This is a Product Management role focused on payments risk, not a Risk Operations or Compliance role. You’ll partner closely with Risk, Compliance, Engineering, Data and Operations to turn risk strategy and policy into scalable product capabilities.

Build Xero’s payments risk capabilities
Own the product strategy and roadmap for merchant and transaction risk.
Build capabilities for merchant eligibility, underwriting, risk segmentation, financial exposure management and ongoing monitoring.
Build transaction fraud detection, monitoring and decisioning capabilities using signals, rules, scoring, velocity and limits.
Develop controls for disputes, chargebacks, reserves, holds, negative balances and payout risk.
Build the tooling and workflows needed to support investigation, review and risk operations.
Build risk as a scalable platform capability
Develop reusable capabilities for risk decisioning, rules, signals, limits, monitoring, alerts and case management.
Partner with Engineering and Data on APIs, data models, architecture and decisioning systems required to operate risk at scale.
Design capabilities that can support multiple processors, payment methods and markets.
Evaluate build-versus-partner decisions and determine where Xero should own risk capabilities versus rely on processors or specialist risk providers.
Make the right risk trade-offs
Translate risk appetite and policy into product controls and customer experiences.
Use data to balance fraud and financial loss against merchant friction, transaction conversion and operational cost.
Establish clear risk metrics and continuously improve decision quality, false-positive rates and loss performance.
Identify emerging merchant, fraud and loss patterns and evolve controls as risks change.

Deep, hands-on payments risk product experience is essential for this role.
We’re looking for someone who has built and operated risk capabilities within a payments platform, PSP, acquirer, PayFac, marketplace or similar payments environment.
You should have meaningful Product Management experience across both:
Merchant risk: KYB/KYC, merchant onboarding, eligibility, underwriting, merchant risk assessment, financial exposure management and/or ongoing monitoring.
Transaction risk: fraud detection and decisioning, transaction monitoring, disputes and chargebacks, reserves and holds, payout risk and/or payments loss management.

Significant Product Management experience in a technically complex payments or fintech environment.
Strong understanding of how merchant risk, transaction risk and the movement of money create financial exposure.
Experience building risk decisioning capabilities using rules, signals, scoring, limits and data-driven models.
Strong analytical skills and experience using fraud, transaction and loss data to make product decisions.
Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Data Science, Risk, Compliance and Operations.
Experience working with payment processors, acquirers and/or third-party risk providers.
Strong product judgement and the ability to make decisions where customer experience, growth and risk are in tension.
We’re particularly interested in candidates whose experience extends beyond KYC/compliance or consumer identity fraud into broader merchant and transaction risk within a payments environment.
Success looks like
Legitimate merchants can accept payments with minimal unnecessary friction.
Higher-risk merchants and transactions are identified and treated appropriately.
Fraud, chargebacks and payments losses remain within Xero’s agreed risk appetite.
Risk capabilities and decisioning can scale across processors, payment methods and markets.

We power some of the world’s most well-respected institutional investors, corporations, and consultancies through the largest and most comprehensive database of primary and market information. Our products and services enable clients to discover unmatched insights and answers to the most challenging questions they face to help them make better informed decisions.
Join the Financial Data Team at AlphaSense as a Product Manager specializing in Financial Data Generation & Presentation. Successful candidates will bring a strong analytical mindset, proficiency in financial reporting and structured financial data, and the ability to drive alignment across technical and business stakeholders.

Own and evolve AlphaSense's proprietary financial data taxonomy, inclusive of financial metrics reported across sectors, accounting standards, statements, and reporting patterns, ensuring both backwards compatibility and future proofing.
Understand financial data consumption patterns of capital markets participants and define how data generation rules apply across all sectors and data types, ensuring clients can intuitively discover, understand, and leverage the data AlphaSense has to offer.
Serve as the internal subject matter expert on financial data generation and presentation, and develop and maintain official internal and external documentation ensuring data standards are clearly articulated and accessible to all stakeholders.
Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, research, product, sales, and client-facing teams to align stakeholders on financial data generation and presentation rules and translate them into a dataset with depth, accuracy, and relevance to clients.
Proactively identify gaps and inconsistencies as new companies, metrics, and datasets are onboarded, driving efficient resolution in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
Define the use cases and requirements for new financial datasets that extend beyond the three core financial statements, driving their onboarding in a structured and scalable way.
Design and maintain financial data structures and taxonomy with AI and LLM compatibility as a core consideration, ensuring labels, definitions, and conventions support model training, inference, and broader AI-driven automation.
Lay the foundation for financial data expansion through building repeatable frameworks and processes, while positioning the dataset for scalable accuracy, relevance, and growth.

Bachelor's degree in a highly analytical field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related discipline
5+ years of experience working with data structures, taxonomy, or data governance, with at least 2 years in a product management or closely adjacent cross-functional role
A genuine interest in financial data and capital markets, with an understanding of how investors and financial professionals consume, interpret, and act on data
A proven analytical mindset, with the ability to translate complex, ambiguous data challenges into structured frameworks and scalable solutions
Hands-on experience leveraging AI and LLM tools as an internal practitioner and a genuine curiosity for how consumers of financial data are integrating AI into their workflows
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams and competing priorities independently
Proficiency in data management tools such as SQL and Python, with a willingness to expand your toolkit as the role evolves

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.
Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all.

That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.
Huntress now secures more than 5M+ endpoints and 15M+ identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

We are building a product management organization to own and drive our product strategy, and we are looking for an experienced product manager to own a new team focused entirely on Security tooling for the Huntress SOC.
Our SOC is the cornerstone of the Huntress Security Platform, serving SMB and mid-market clients through MSP/MSSP and Reseller channels. It delivers premium, human+AI services at a scale most companies can't match — Rapid Response, Tactical Response, and Hypercare together accounted for roughly 150 engagements in a single recent month.

Much of that delivery still runs on an internal SOC platform that does not match analysts' current needs - this includes spreadsheets, Slack threads, and per-engagement documents. Our analysts work on a surface that has never had a first-class experience.
You will own the internal security experience: the surface our SOC works in every day, the tooling that makes our response services repeatable, and the shared investigation and evidence model the rest of the SOC platform is built on.

This is the delivery engine behind the margin thesis — the work that enables us to grow the business without growing SOC headcount linearly. It is also the foundation layer, so the interfaces you publish are consumed by our agentic automation team and our partner-facing product team.
Your users are professional security analysts, and they are down the hall. You will get direct, immediate, unfiltered feedback on everything you ship from people who do this work for a living.
You will work closely with SOC leadership, engineering leaders, support, and other Product Managers. To be successful in this position, you need real fluency in how a SOC actually operates — how analysts triage, investigate, escalate, and report — and the judgment to tell the difference between a workflow that needs product support versus not.

You will be building internal-facing systems where the return is measured in analyst throughput and time-to-close rather than ARR, and you will need to make that case clearly to executive stakeholders.

Work with the Director of Product, the Head of SOC, and other relevant stakeholders to set the SOC tooling vision and strategy, and clearly articulate the business value so that everyone understands where we are headed
Own the roadmap for analyst UX, Rapid Response and Tactical Response tooling, product support and operations, and SOC platform
Serve as the primary steward of the shared investigation and evidence model — canvas, queues, triage package — and publish the interface adjacent product teams build on
Partner with SOC leadership, analysts, and Tactical Response to turn manual, out-of-product processes into standardized, automation-first internal workflows
Take ownership of the Portal Enhancement Kit and drive analyst-built improvements into the native product so the best of internal tooling becomes the best of product
Demonstrate an ability to decipher and articulate potentially ambiguous operator needs and mold them into successful, innovative solutions
Work with designers, engineers, and architects to create detailed business requirements, epics, and user stories that will be used to shape product specifications and architecture
Participate as a key contributor in all phases of product development, from discovery to launch
Protect a capacity floor for resiliency and technical debt, and hold the line on it against feature pressure
Serve as the intermediary between engineering and senior management and other non-technical stakeholders, with the ability to break down and translate highly technical information into layman's terms and vice versa
Work with design and engineering teams to produce mockups, wireframes, and prototypes to assess the validity and strength of a new capability
Define and report operational metrics — time-to-close, throughput per analyst, repeatability of delivery — to track and evaluate the success of the strategy
